subject: afn
title: AFN.------ASP.ES.
description: Chart on book p. 186 (EVOL-24). AFN (affinity negation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ASP-ES (aspect essence) is the partner. From the subject: AFL (affinity alignment). INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from the subject. From AFL: TRS (transition), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From TRS: TF-SH (transfer shifts), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", PHY-U-C (physical universe context), INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and POL-P (political policies), with the (P-AT) prefix, "point of activation". POL-SIGN (political significance) is on a dotted line from TRS.
